name: Crystal Chandelier Lamp
desc: A decorative crystal chandelier featuring a circular gold-tone frame, multiple vertical clear crystal prisms, and a central multi-arm lamp arrangement. The layered crystal design creates a luxurious ambient lighting effect suitable for premium residential and hospitality interiors.

specifications.Shade / Decorative Elements: Clear vertical crystal prisms arranged in layered rings
specifications.Light Distribution: Ambient decorative illumination with crystal refraction
specifications.Finish: Gold-tone metal with clear crystal elements
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Dining room / Lobby / Hotel / Premium residential interiors
